{{Top|leg}}
'''Team Ripper''' was a unit within the free-lance [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] organization [[Rusher's Brigade]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. They participated during the [[Second Charge Matrica]], fighting in the [[Battle of Gazzari]] and the [[Siege of Calimondretta]]. They were led by a [[Gender/Legends|female]] named [[Zeller]].
